user.title: Additional CA
user.description: Set up Additional CA to manage additional certificate authorities from the UI. Certificate authorities declared in configuration.yaml are imported automatically.

init.title: Additional certificate authorities
init.description:
{cas}

Removing or disabling a certificate authority is fully applied after Home Assistant is restarted.

add.title: Add a certificate authority
add.description: Upload a certificate authority file in PEM format.

toggle.title: Enable or disable certificate authorities
toggle.description: Only the checked certificate authorities are enabled.

delete.title: Delete certificate authorities
delete.description: The selected certificate authorities and their files are deleted. Certificate authorities declared in configuration.yaml must be removed from configuration.yaml.

error.invalid_name: The name must contain letters or digits.
error.already_exists: A certificate authority with this name already exists.
error.invalid_certificate: The file is not a valid PEM certificate.
error.cannot_write: The certificate file could not be saved.

needs_restart.title: Home Assistant needs to be restarted

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant now?
confirm.description: This will restart Home Assistant so the certificate {ca_filename} (Common Name {common_name}) can be reloaded into the SSL Context.
